trend: Plan of Action: the 'placebo' column (benefits people don't feel day to day)
why: An honest Trust post from the retention plan. It sets expectations, so people don't quit when vitamins don't 'feel' like anything.
text:
Some of SILT you'll feel within a week: steadier energy, falling asleep faster.

Some you won't feel at all. Nobody wakes up feeling more vitamin D or B12. That's why every dose is printed on the pack and every ingredient has a lab report: so you can trust the quiet part too.
